quote: A driver commits an offense of aggressive driving if, during any single, continuous period of driving within the course of 1 mile, the driver does all the following, in any sequence: (a) Commits one or more acts of speeding in violation of NRS 484B.363 or 484B.600 [NRS-484B-363-1, NRS-484B-363-2, NRS-484B-600-1a, NRS-484B-600-1b, NRS-484B-600-1c, NRS-484B-600-1e]. (b) Commits two or more of the following acts, in any combination, or commits any of the following acts more than once: (1) Failing to obey an official traffic-control device in violation of NRS 484B.300 [NRS-484B-300-1]. (2) Overtaking and passing another vehicle upon the right by driving off the paved portion of the highway in violation of NRS 484B.210 [NRS-484B-210-3]. (3) Improper or unsafe driving upon a highway that has marked lanes for traffic in violation of NRS 484B.223 [NRS-484B-223-1b, NRS-484B-223-2, NRS-484B-223-3a, NRS-484B-223-3b, NRS-484B-223-3c, NRS-484B-223-4a, NRS-484B-223-4b]. (4) Following another vehicle too closely in violation of NRS 484B.127 [LVMC-11-12-080-A, NRS-484B-127-2, NRS-484B-127-3]. (5) Failing to yield the right-of-way in violation of any provision of NRS 484B.250 to 484B.267, inclusive [NRS-484B-250-1, NRS-484B-250-2, NRS-484B-250-3, NRS-484B-250-4, NRS-484B-253, NRS-484B-257-1, NRS-484B-257-2, NRS-484B-260, NRS-484B-263, NRS-484B-267-1a, NRS-484B-267-1b, NRS-484B-267-1c, NRS-484B-267-2a, NRS-484B-267-2b, NRS-484B-267-2c, NRS-484B-267-2d, NRS-484B-267-2e, NRS-484B-267-2f]. (c) Creates an immediate hazard, regardless of its duration, to another vehicle or to another person, whether or not the other person is riding in or upon the vehicle of the driver or any other vehicle.

activation.condition: One driver continuously drives through a single course of no more than one mile.

obligation.description: Within that continuous one-mile course, do not combine one or more independently established speeding violations, at least two independently established listed acts (including repetition of one category), and an independently established immediate hazard to a person or another vehicle. The source text is a composite offense; this proposal does not adjudicate constituent provisions.

timing.description: All groups may occur in any sequence within one single continuous period of driving; immediate hazard has no minimum duration.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The referenced following provisions require separate source-grounded review; a headway sample is not a legal threshold.
The referenced marked-lane provisions require independent activation, context and judgment.
Duration is irrelevant under this clause; original participant and conflict evidence still require independent review.
